title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1501: Blooming skylotus (3)

section.p: He only hoped that the punishment would come in the form of the Source Return Blade instead of the regular lightning tribulation.
Please let it be the Source Return Blade.
The Source Return Blade was supposed to be the embodiment of the heavenly laws on the seventh level.
Su Yu prayed inwardly.
Finally, his prayers were answered. With a hum, a blinding blade soared into the sky. At the same time, Heavencurse’s expression changed drastically.
“NOO!”
A miserable wail rang out.

He was the top-ranked genius on the Dao Affirmation Ranking! He was someone capable of killing Invincibles! Someone like him shouldn’t die like this! This was not possible! He was a super genius! The moment he completed his dao affirmation, he would jump straight to the fourth or even the fifth degree.
He would become a powerful Eternal. He would start his climb toward Daofuse. It wouldn’t even take that long. He was not destined to die here!

The Source Return Blade struck, cutting Heavencurse into two. Everything about that body was erased. The second Heavencurse appeared, but it was cut into two again. Next, the third body appeared. Yes. Heavencurse had formed his third body. Right as the third body emerged, Su Yu timed his punch and landed it on the body. Boom! The body was blasted apart.
Dark clouds appeared in the sky.

Yes. Heavencurse was so impressive that his death was generating a phenomenon like he was an Invincible. Clearly, even the heavens were treating Heavencurse as an Invincible. Unfortunately, the heavenly laws were merciless. They would not show anyone mercy. The heavenly laws here, in particular, were meant to deal with death sovereigns. There was no surviving this.

Heavencurse was dead. All the surrounding death spirits trembled with fear, including Xing Yue and He Tu. The death sovereigns who had been transferred here by the heavenly laws also stopped all actions in fear.
Source Return Blade.
A blade meant to punish all lawbreakers.

Meanwhile, Su Yu was cursing inwardly. He had only killed the third body. The heavenly laws had taken most of the credit for the kill. The heavenly rewards were insufficient for him to complete another transformation.
Holy shit!
Suddenly, his gaze landed on Spiritvenge. At the moment, Spiritvenge had an unsightly expression.
Heavencurse was dead.
Damn it!
How did Su Yu do that?

They all knew that Lan Tian was capable of resonating with an unknown existance in the mansion. But none of them knew that Su Yu could do so as well. Even Lan Tian could only resonate with that existence when he was feeling particularly wronged.

However, Su Yu was able to turn the entire seventh level upside down easily. They still weren’t perfectly sure that Su Yu was the culprit, but they believed that to be the case. It was simply too big of a coincidence. How would the seventh level go crazy just when Heavencurse needed full concentration?

Furthermore, no death sovereign had appeared after Heavencurse was killed. Clearly, even the heavenly laws agreed that he deserved death. It was well known that the protection of the heavenly laws did not extend toward those they spurned.
As members of a fallen race, both Spiritvenge and Heavencurse were spurned by the heavenly laws.
Suddenly, Su Yu shouted, “Lan Tian, keep him busy for a short moment.”
The overjoyed Lan Tian roared and sent countless clones toward Spiritvenge. Alarmed, Spiritvenge turned around to flee instead of staying to fight.
At the same time.
Topsoil Spirit was similarly alarmed. He hurriedly sent a voice transmission, “Stop waiting! Do it now, Elder! Stop Spiritvenge for Su Yu! Su Yu has a way to kill him! Don’t hesitate!”
“But Great Qin King is dying…”

“Do it! Su Yu has a trump card! He has resonated with an unknown super expert. The Luminous Domain Mansion…is either a supreme weapon or the residence of a supreme existence who is not fully dead! Do it now! Su Yu is capable of communicating with this supreme existence!”
“Fine.”
The five elemental Invincible flickered and sent an incredibly sharp golden blade toward a certain River of Time. He was an Invincible from the metal elemental race.
The golden blade cut the River of Time apart, forcing the alarmed Spiritvenge out of the river. He roared in fury, “Auspicious Golden! You dare?”
“Kill him!”
Topsoil Spirit shouted.
Not far behind, Su Yu blanked out slightly. This was a complete surprise for him.
Holy shit!
Was the five elemental race helping him?
How unexpected.
He had thought that the five elemental race would stay neutral. What a surprise. They had actually helped him.
Su Yu naturally wouldn’t let go of this chance. He yelled, “Lan Tian, five elemental, keep him busy. Let me finish the job!”
With an expression of bitter resentment, Spiritvenge stared at Su Yu and said, “Let us die together!”
Next, a mouthful of blood spurted out of his mouth. Instantly, the blood turned dark. In a split second, the blood seeped into Su Yu’s head.
“Hahaha! Let us die together!”

Just then, the Source Return Blade moved again. It felt as though it was capable of severing everything in existence. The moment it descended, Spiritvenge lost his body. The second body was cut apart the moment it appeared. After blanking out for a split second, Su Yu roared and threw a punch at the third body.

A rain of blood started falling. At his final moments, Spiritvenge sneered and said, “You will die as well, Su Yu. I’ll be waiting for you in the Death Realm. You won’t survive my Soulbreaker Awl. I’ll be waiting—”
“Are you dumb?”

Su Yu cursed while enjoying the rich heavenly rewards. Like his previous kill, he didn’t get the full credit. But it was enough for him to complete his fourth transformation. As for the dark blood, it didn’t even get through the Culture Tomb.
What a dumb guy.
But the Culture Tomb sure was impressive. The blood could only surround it without dealing any damage to it. Before long, the blood was absorbed clean by the tomb.

Su Yu appeared completely indifferent, but Auspicious Golden looked worried. He hurriedly said, “This isn’t good! The Soulbreaker Awl is very dangerous. Abandon your body and cut your sea of willpower apart! You might yet survive…”
Holy shit!
This was very bad.
That damn Topsoil Spirit was too unreliable. He did as told and helped Su Yu, but Su Yu was going to die right after receiving his help.

The Soulbreaker Awl was the trump card of the celestial chasm race. Back then, Ye Batian had been killed by the same technique as well. This was a technique formed through the blood essence and soul of an Invincible. It would exhaust more than half of one’s strength once used, all to ensure the death of an enemy.
Su Yu was as good as dead. It didn’t matter how freakish he was. He was still a Cloudbreach while this was a technique capable of killing Invincibles.
Su Yu merely smiled and said, “Thank you for your assistance, Senior. Don’t worry. It’s no big deal.”
As his transformation progressed, he said indifferently, “Really, it’s nothing. Don’t worry, Senior. What can a mere Soulbreaker Awl do to me? What can a garbage technique like that do to me?”
Just as Auspicious Golden wanted to say something, Su Yu’s body shook as all 360 of his acupoints released a powerful aura. His entire body lit up, as though he had transformed into a sun.

He had finally completed his fourth transformation. His physical strength had been pushed beyond 8.7 million acupoints. Perhaps he had grown too much, but his yang acupoint could no longer double his strength. Or perhaps Xing Yue was running out of death qi. He didn’t know.
With his latest transformation, the yang acupoint could only boost his strength by about eighty percent.
Su Yu was greatly disappointed. That would only grant him the strength of roughly 15 million acupoints. Was that enough to fight Invincibles? It would probably be hard.

Then again, Su Yu was sure he was already comparable with Pseudo Invincibles with three bodies. He had surpassed two-bodied Pseudo Invincibles. Or to be precise, he had a feeling he had reached the same level as the likes of Heavencurse.
He felt strong.
He felt very strong.
Should he try fighting an Invincible? But with the River of Time, it was unlikely that he could even land an attack on an Invincible. How annoying.
Auspicious Golden was completely dumbstruck as he stared at the shiny and golden Su Yu.
Holy shit!
Was this really happening?
Just surviving the Soulbreaker Awl was already a very big deal. How did Su Yu grow even stronger in such a short time? He was already starting to feel like an Invincible.
Su Yu said, “Senior, can you help me with the two immortal kings?”
“Yes…sure…”

Auspicious Golden was still blanking out. He finally understood Topsoil Spirit. This was a freak. This was an absolute freak. A freak of nature. If he managed to grow to maturity, humanity would definitely rise in power.
Spiritvenge marked the eighth Invincible to die today.
Heavencurse was not counted since he was not an Invincible.
Eight Invincibles.
Three divines, three immortals, one devil, and one celestial chasm.
Next, a miserable wail rang out.

As the sole Invincible of the five elemental race in the mansion, Auspicious Golden was incredibly strong as well. His sole task here was to protect Topsoil Spirit. To be precise, he was a sixth-degree Eternal.
The moment he joined the fight, golden radiance washed over the area. He was still in his peak condition. Thus, he could easily handle an immortal king who was already forced out of his merged state.

With Zhu Tianfang’s help, he was able to instantly kill the immortal king. At the same time, a heaven weapon exploded. Countless immortals flew in all directions, but all of them died before they could go far.
With that, Immortal King Xuan He became the sole immortal survivor in the mansion. Everyone else had died.
With a bleak smile, Immortal King Xuan He said, “Sigh. The immortals…have been at peace for too long. We have a lot of experts…but we have grown soft from the prolonged peace…”

Then, a large number of Invincibles swarmed him, instantly killing him. Immortal King Xuan He had been killed. Two new death sovereigns arrived. Not a single celestial chasm and immortal remained in the mansion.
A blood rain started falling again while a suffocating silence descended. Even Great Qin King was stunned.
Dead?
So many of them?
These people had killed even more Invincibles than him.

Ten Invincibles had died so far. Only eleven Invincibles were left around Great Qin King. Two divines, six devils, two dragons, and a nether. The phoenix Invincible was still in a standstill with He Tu.
“Department Head!”
Blood Fire Devil King said, “Are you going to continue staying out of this? You from the fate race, are you going to keep watching?”
The devils had not suffered much, but the immortals had been wiped out.
The two remaining divine kings were badly injured, while the dragons and nether were trembling with fear. Even with Great Qin King’s second body near death, they were starting to grow fearful.

The humans…had somehow killed ten Invincibles. Fortunately, the other human kings were currently kept busy by the death sovereigns. After seeing that Great Qin King wouldn’t be easy to kill, the death sovereigns had decided to target Xia Longwu and the others instead.
Thus, Xia Longwu and Auspicious Golden were kept busy by eight death sovereigns. It felt as though things were growing more and more troublesome for them even after killing so many Invincibles.
Blood Fire Devil King was starting to worry. He was worried that after killing Great Qin King, the Heaven Department head would do something unexpected.
Silence descended.
Things were starting to become clear.

The humans would still be defeated, but the other races would suffer major losses tot achieve victory. Great Qin King was still alive, with the remaining Invincibles around him growing wary of his last desperate attack. Just then, Su Yu said, “Looks like in the end, the humans, immortals, divines, and dragons will suffer while the devils and Heavenly Hunt Pavilion will be the biggest winners. Who will win more?”
Right at that moment, a lotus bloomed in the sky.

After so many deaths, the enchanting lotus was finally blooming, swaying about gently. It had matured. Its fragrance spread all over the seventh level. After absorbing the nutrients of so many experts, it had finally matured.
Of the remaining Invincibles, there were five humans, six devils, two divines, two dragons, one elemental, one nether, one fate, one phoenix, and one from the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion.

The humans might have a respectable number left, but all of them were badly injured. Even with the assistance of the five elemental race, things still weren’t looking that good for them. One should not forget that Xia Longwu and the others were still surrounded by the death sovereigns.
The humans were still in danger.
